argv:
[Console]::OutputEncoding=New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
foreach($log in @('Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-PnP/Configuration','Microsoft-Windows-DriverFrameworks-UserMode/Operational','System')) {
  Write-Output "@@log=$log"
  Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName=$log;StartTime=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(-20)} -MaxEvents 400 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Where-Object {$_.ProviderName -match 'PnP|USB|DriverFrameworks|DeviceSetup' -or $_.Message -match 'VID_0525|VID_18D1|VID_0000&PID_0002|GTS9'} |
    Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,ProviderName,LevelDisplayName,Message | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
}
